observed_2026_09_06: Issue #200 ranks Café / Foodware as S priority and favors low-complexity props that bundle well into cafe sets.
Current canonical catalog contains cups, saucers, trays, plates, dessert props, menu stand, cake stand and sugar jar but no napkin-holder SKU.
Current BOOTH lamp and world-prop examples confirm lightweight world props commonly occupy the low-hundreds-of-yen price band; this SKU uses a conservative JPY 200 single hypothesis.
The design reuses only the existing box component, has a clear thumbnail silhouette and can bundle with existing cafe counter/tableware props.
